author: blu
body: The only live builder of an OffsetTable lives in `codex/Emit/X86_64Chapter.codex` as `build-offset-table-parallel`, which takes parallel `List Text` + `List Integer` and threads them through `offset-table-set`. The earlier `build-offset-table : List FuncOffset` here was unused dead code; it pulled `FuncOffset` (defined far away in `Emit/X86_64State.codex`) into Core's surface and made any plug-style bundle that includes Core but not Emit emit unresolved-type errors against it. Keeping Core self-contained sidesteps that.
